Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_display_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_unit_count number := 0;
 v_local_time date;
 cursor c1 is
 select u.unit_id, u.chk_digit, u.coll_date, donor_decision_code ddc,
 catalog_number, drive_id, group_site_id,
 red_tube_flag, purple_tube_flag,
 serum_plasma_ind, red_tube2,
 bleed_start_time, bleed_end_time,
 qc_checkin_date
 from units u
 where batch_id = :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id
 and u.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and (u.coll_date is null or
 red_tube_flag is null or
 purple_tube_flag is null or
 serum_plasma_ind is null or
 red_tube2 is null or
 donor_decision_code is null or
 bleed_start_time is null or
 bleed_end_time is null)
 and u.unit_id not in (select a.unit_id
 from unit_attributes a
 where attrib_code = '14'
 and trunc(u.coll_date) =
 trunc(a.coll_date)
 and u.chapter_id =
 a.chapter_id)
 order by u.unit_id;
 cursor c2 is
 select u.unit_id, u.chk_digit, u.coll_date, donor_decision_code ddc,
 catalog_number, drive_id, group_site_id,
 red_tube_flag, purple_tube_flag,
 serum_plasma_ind, red_tube2,
 bleed_start_time, bleed_end_time,
 qc_checkin_date
 from units u
 where batch_id = :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id
 and u.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
/* Commended out by Subhash as this appears to be a mistake
 and (red_tube_flag is not null or
 purple_tube_flag is not null)
 and (red_tube_flag is not null and
 purple_tube_flag is not null)
*/
 and u.unit_id in (select a.unit_id
 from unit_attributes a
 where attrib_code = '14'
 and trunc(u.coll_date) =
 trunc(a.coll_date)
 and u.chapter_id =
 a.chapter_id)
 order by u.unit_id;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 :s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 temp_display_flag := 'N';
 go_block('units_info');
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 temp_display_flag := 'Y';
 temp_unit_count := temp_unit_count + 1;
 :units_info.unit_id := c1_rec.unit_id;
 :units_info.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(c1_rec.unit_id,'','');
 :units_info.coll_date := c1_rec.coll_date;
 :units_info.donor_decision_code := c1_rec.ddc;
 :units_info.catalog_number := c1_rec.catalog_number; ---bag_code;
 :units_info.drive_id := c1_rec.drive_id;
 :units_info.group_site_id := substr(c1_rec.group_site_id,-6);
 :units_info.red_tube_flag := c1_rec.red_tube_flag;
 :units_info.red_tube2 := c1_rec.red_tube2;
 :units_info.serum_plasma_ind := c1_rec.serum_plasma_ind;
 :units_info.purple_tube_flag := c1_rec.purple_tube_flag;
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, c1_rec.bleed_start_time, v_local_time);
 :units_info.bleed_start_time := v_local_time;
 else
 :units_info.bleed_start_time := c1_rec.bleed_start_time;
 end if;
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, c1_rec.bleed_end_time, v_local_time);
 :units_info.bleed_end_time := v_local_time;
 else
 :units_info.bleed_end_time := c1_rec.bleed_end_time;
 end if; 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, c1_rec.qc_checkin_date, v_local_time); 
 :units_info.qc_checkin_date := v_local_time;
 else
 :units_info.qc_checkin_date := c1_rec.qc_checkin_date;
 end if;
 
 --:units_info.bleed_start_time := c1_rec.bleed_start_time;
 -- :units_info.bleed_end_time := c1_rec.bleed_end_time;
 --:units_info.qc_checkin_date := c1_rec.qc_checkin_date;
 down;
 end loop;
 for c2_rec in c2
 loop
 temp_display_flag := 'Y';
 temp_unit_count := temp_unit_count + 1;
 :units_info.unit_id := c2_rec.unit_id;
 :units_info.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(c2_rec.unit_id,'','');
 :units_info.coll_date := c2_rec.coll_date;
 :units_info.donor_decision_code := c2_rec.ddc;
 --:units_info.bag_code := c2_rec.bag_code;
 :units_info.catalog_number:= c2_rec.catalog_number;
 :units_info.drive_id := c2_rec.drive_id;
 :units_info.group_site_id := c2_rec.group_site_id;
 :units_info.red_tube_flag := c2_rec.red_tube_flag;
 :units_info.red_tube2 := c2_rec.red_tube2;
 :units_info.serum_plasma_ind := c2_rec.serum_plasma_ind;
 :units_info.purple_tube_flag := c2_rec.purple_tube_flag;
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, c2_rec.bleed_start_time, v_local_time);
 :units_info.bleed_start_time := v_local_time;
 else
 :units_info.bleed_start_time := c2_rec.bleed_start_time;
 end if;
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, c2_rec.bleed_end_time, v_local_time);
 :units_info.bleed_end_time := v_local_time;
 else
 :units_info.bleed_end_time := c2_rec.bleed_end_time;
 end if; 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, c2_rec.qc_checkin_date, v_local_time); 
 :units_info.qc_checkin_date := v_local_time;
 else
 :units_info.qc_checkin_date := c2_rec.qc_checkin_date;
 end if;

 -- :units_info.bleed_start_time := c2_rec.bleed_start_time;
 -- :units_info.bleed_end_time := c2_rec.bleed_end_time;
 -- :units_info.qc_checkin_date := c2_rec.qc_checkin_date;
 down;
 end loop;
 if temp_display_flag = 'N'
 then
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.batch_id');
 show_error('6067');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 :s_unit_count := temp_unit_count;
 clear_record;
 go_record('1');
 end if;
 if :units_info.unit_id is not null
 then
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('UNITS_INFO.UNIT_ID',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'UNITS_INFO.UNIT_ID', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE );
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select distinct b.batch_id
 into :batch_id
 from batch_inputs b
 where batch_id = :batch_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and b.batch_id in (select units.batch_id
 from units
 where units.batch_id = b.batch_id
 and substr(units.batch_id,8,2) =
 'CB'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error('1130');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-MENU
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
begin

 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from unit_attributes
 where unit_id = :units_info.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and trunc(coll_date) =
 trunc(:units_info.coll_date);

 if temp_count = 0
 then
 show_error('0202');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 go_block('units_attrib');
 execute_query;
 end if;
 end;
end;

Block.Name: UNITS_ATTRIB
Block.WhereClause: where unit_id = :units_info.unit_id and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:units_info.coll_date)

Item.Name: ATTRIB_GROUP
Item.Hint: Press up or down arrow keys to scroll up or down, respectively. PF4 to exit

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 begin
 select code_desc
 into :units_attrib.s_group_desc
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'ATTR' and
 code = :units_attrib.attrib_group and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select attrib_desc
 into :units_attrib.s_code_desc
 from valid_attributes
 where attrib_group = :units_attrib.attrib_group and
 attrib_code = :units_attrib.attrib_code and
 unit_scheme_type = decode(NVL(length(:units_info.unit_id), 0), 7, 'C', 13,'I') and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;
